title: Mira and the Puddle Duck
blurb: Mira finds a tiny duckling in the big puddle in her garden and walks it home to the pond, one wet step at a time.

beats.ch01.s01.b002: The rain has stopped. The puddle is as round as a plate.
beats.ch01.s02.b002: The duck has big feet and a very small tail. It peeps at Mira.
beats.ch01.s03.b002: Flap, flap, flap! The drops make tiny rainbows.
beats.ch01.s04.b002: "You are a puddle duck," Mira whispers. The duck peeps again.
beats.ch01.s05.b002: The stones are slippery. Mira takes one slow step, then another.
beats.ch01.s06.b002: Pip has walked a long way for such small feet. It needs a rest.
beats.ch01.s07.b002: "You are light as a feather," says Mira. The duck is warm and soft.
beats.ch01.s08.b002: The pond shines in the sun. Pip knows this water.
beats.ch01.s09.b002: Splash, splash! The water makes rings all the way to the reeds.
beats.ch01.s10.b002: The frog blinks once. Then it hops away into the reeds.
beats.ch01.s11.b002: "Goodbye, puddle duck," says Mira. "Come and visit my garden."
beats.ch01.s12.b002: "You have been busy," says Mama. "There is a duck in your hair too."
beats.ch01.s13.b002: The kettle sings. The cocoa is warm and sweet.
beats.ch01.s14.b002: The puddle glows like a little pond. "Goodnight, puddle," Mira says.
